caption:
A morning reminder on gratitude: count these three gifts

Allah brought us out of our mothers' wombs knowing nothing, and He gave us hearing, sight and intellect so that we may be grateful. Each one is a gift we use from the first minute of the day.

Surah An-Nahl 16:78

Pick one of the three and thank Allah for it this morning.

#gratitude #shukr #surahnahl #fridayreminder

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
